title: FIVE POINTS OF THE STAR OF JACOB
theme: The Star of Jacob points to Christ's kingship, brightness, guidance, wonder, and glory.
proposition: Christ, the Star of Jacob, is the King whose light guides sinners to freedom and points to heavenly glory.
sermonQuestion: What do the five points of the Star of Jacob reveal about Christ?
